standing: Authored definitions, scoped derivations and observed local work. Broad transfer remains a hypothesis.

distinctions.case: Conflict resolution method selection can be investigated through several studies.
distinctions.consequence: Studies does not need to be appended to every canonical subject name.

distinctions.relation: Investigating an operation versus performing it
distinctions.case: A person can resolve a dispute without investigating resolution methods; an investigator can compare methods without resolving the live dispute.
distinctions.consequence: Practice exposes separate applicability, execution, contribution and learning questions.

distinctions.case: A conditional optimality proof can hold in its model while a live case violates an assumption.
distinctions.consequence: Theoretical and applied are roles with different result obligations, not automatic top-level subjects.

distinctions.case: A person prepares for rain without saying it will rain; a spokesperson can announce a forecast they do not personally expect.
distinctions.consequence: Preserve the distinct targets without imposing this one sense of prediction on every technical literature.

distinctions.case: An agent can expect a delay without taking any preparatory action.
distinctions.consequence: Expectation content and its use can fail independently.

distinctions.relation: Hidden current state versus possible later event
distinctions.case: A model estimates the present source of a sensation without representing a future consequence.
distinctions.consequence: Not every model-generated prediction is future anticipation.

distinctions.case: An assistant announces a response plan and then follows it.
distinctions.consequence: Agreement may show successful control; it does not alone measure independent forecasting accuracy.

distinctions.relation: Newly usable structure versus changed grading
distinctions.case: A hidden alternative becomes visible under the same goal; in a different case the same alternatives are merely graded by a new goal.
distinctions.consequence: Only the first directly supports an information or representation improvement under the original task.

distinctions.case: A large departure can be harmful; a small departure can remove a bottleneck.
distinctions.consequence: Positive is the outcome of a specified comparison, not part of the primitive definition of deviation.

distinctions.case: Exploration has a real discovery objective or information benefit excluded by a narrower apparent task.
distinctions.consequence: Do not diagnose inefficiency by silently deleting exploration's contribution.

distinctions.case: Two choices trade off participant gains even though a third improves both.
distinctions.consequence: A local tradeoff does not establish a zero-sum game.

distinctions.relation: Declared comparison domain versus unrestricted quantifier
distinctions.case: For any favored act, construct a perspective whose sole goal is avoiding that act.
distinctions.consequence: Universal goodness over arbitrary goals is generally unattainable; the admitted perspective set is substantive.

distinctions.b: Identity of everything with one perspective
distinctions.relation: A usable interpretation versus an ontological identity
distinctions.case: A biological process can be represented as allocation while its kinetic or geometric details remain necessary for particular questions.
distinctions.consequence: Demonstrate the mapping and what it makes inferable; a universal renaming does not establish explanation.

distinctions.case: A theory can have a loose title and precise equations; a literal title can accompany an empty account.
distinctions.consequence: Inspect naming precision and substantive content separately.

distinctions.case: Interpersonal disputes instantiate a specified conflict with participants and institutional constraints.
distinctions.consequence: Use Conflict resolution method selection generally; add an interpersonal qualification when it changes the actual scope, assumptions or methods.

distinctions.case: Calculate a rotated representation without identifying how a person's internal representation changes.
distinctions.consequence: The user's shorter general name is retained, while the mechanism question remains independently identifiable.

frame_applications.native: Performance is described by task success.
frame_applications.transformation: For each candidate operation, represent the later questions, resources and conditions its use would create; compare reachable continuations.
frame_applications.result: A currently successful operation can be inferior when it removes the only route to a required later result.
frame_applications.limit: Anticipatory structure does not by itself establish every capability or explain all intelligence.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: The next answer is generated as a locally coherent continuation.
frame_applications.transformation: Represent a prospective contribution, then use that representation to construct the next prompt and test which continuation becomes necessary or avoidable.
frame_applications.result: A response can resolve a dependency before explaining it, or expose a missing distinction before producing a conclusion.
frame_applications.limit: This is an external prompting operation; its benefit and the model's hidden internal state are separate claims.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: An act is judged under a stated normative rule.
frame_applications.transformation: Derive who will face which later choices, commitments or losses under each candidate act, while holding the rule explicit.
frame_applications.result: A previously omitted consequence can change the premises of the moral judgment.
frame_applications.limit: Expected consequences do not by themselves justify the normative rule or settle all deontological obligations.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: A plan specifies a sequence or contingency.
frame_applications.transformation: Start from anticipated future conditions and work backward to what must already be available when each is reached.
frame_applications.result: Preparation requirements appear before the point at which failure would otherwise be noticed.
frame_applications.limit: An expected event is not an intended goal; reachability and feasibility still require their own arguments.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: An option is selected from a fixed visible list.
frame_applications.transformation: For each option, represent its possible consequences, the information obtained, and the later options it preserves or removes.
frame_applications.result: The decision can select an information-producing action or preserve an otherwise invisible later option.
frame_applications.limit: Uncertain inputs remain uncertain; a supplied consequence model is not evidence that its values are true.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: A biological process is classified by organ or mechanism.
frame_applications.transformation: Identify actual limited resources, competing uses, constraints, and the changes in feasible outcomes when those allocations change.
frame_applications.result: A resource bottleneck can become comparable across otherwise different biological settings.
frame_applications.limit: Kinetics, geometry, development and other details can remain indispensable; not every question is settled by the allocation view.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: A performance is classified by a familiar mental faculty.
frame_applications.transformation: Specify the competing demands and which representations or actions remain available under the observed distribution of resources.
frame_applications.result: A failure attributed to absent capacity can instead become a test of availability, interference or access.
frame_applications.limit: This is a proposed explanatory alternative, not a universal identity or a biological mechanism already observed.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: The conflict is framed as selecting which party wins now.
frame_applications.transformation: Construct the later uses and responses made possible by each arrangement and look for altered constraints or sequences.
frame_applications.result: Scheduling can introduce an option that improves both parties relative to an immediate clash.
frame_applications.limit: A nonzero-sum opportunity must be feasible and evidenced in the actual case; imagined agreement is not resolution.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

frame_applications.native: A field's current labels define where its methods are considered applicable.
frame_applications.transformation: Translate its operative relations into a new target and test which premises survive and which questions become answerable.
frame_applications.result: Previously separated literatures can share a method or reveal a genuinely missing target.
frame_applications.limit: Successful translation of one relation is not complete reduction of the new field.
frame_applications.standing: Authored reconstruction and its consequence; transfer claim limited to the stated construction.

source_reconciliation.residual: No one atomic subject is asserted equivalent to the entire construct. Mechanisms and measurement remain separate.
Does not select a unique biological implementation or prove that a listed task isolates maintenance.
Flexibility still needs task-dependent switching conditions; the label does not supply a mechanism.
A measured limit is not assumed fixed across all contents, supports or tasks.
The occurrence of interference and the effectiveness of a control operation require different comparisons.

naming_execution.subject: Reasoning approach selection
naming_execution.case: Generalize shape rotation naming without losing the distinct transformation and mechanism questions.
requirements: Retain a distinct matter for the transformed representation and for how it is produced.
Allow an explicitly qualified internal-human case without making it the entire general scope.
Preserve stable IDs and source titles while updating current canonical references.

candidates.examined_result: Produces a general label for the earlier mechanism definition while leaving a second general transformation entry under its old name.
candidates.reason: Does not establish the boundary between transformation result and production mechanism.

candidates.approach: Retain the internal-human scope as the canonical general entry
candidates.examined_result: Preserves the earlier internal case but leaves computational and physical implementations outside that general entry.
candidates.reason: Fails the requested general scope; it can remain a qualified case.

candidates.approach: Compare completion conditions and reconstruct the target family
candidates.anticipated_contribution: Literal general name with consequential distinctions retained
candidates.examined_result: The transformation becomes Shape representation rotation; the mechanism becomes Shape representation rotation mechanism. Duration and fidelity remain independently named.
candidates.reason: Meets the four case requirements without adding an unnecessary mental qualifier to the general operation.

result_changes.effect: General representation transformation retained; parent now Shape representation.
Mechanism question generalized; the earlier human-internal scope is retained as a qualification, not declared coextensive.

naming_execution.actual_result: Two current definitions and their canonical references revised; change records preserve prior scopes. This is an executed local naming result, not a general selector performance estimate.
limits: Only the stated case and three candidate approaches were compared.
No universal optimality, controlled effectiveness result or exact original Reasoningtool skill execution is claimed.
The selector chooses an approach; executing the approach and propagating its result remain distinguishable operations.

deviation_case.standing: Authored finite mathematical example; all payoffs are stipulated, not measurements of people.
deviation_case.matter: One resource, two participants, six admitted arrangements.
deviation_case.preference_direction: Larger is better for both criteria.
interpretation_limits: Feasibility and these payoff values are assumptions.
A and B are the admitted evaluative perspectives; a joint-sum objective is an additional rule, not an independent observation.
The example establishes conditional comparisons, not efficacy of scheduling in a real conflict.
A finite deterministic case supplies no general claim about uncertain scenarios or repeated games.

questions.subject: Perspective consequence accessibility
questions.question: When two representations carry equivalent information, which operation or resource difference explains why one makes a consequence available and the other does not?
questions.next_result: A finite task with equivalent inputs but an explicitly bounded operation budget.

questions.subject: Perspective scope extension
questions.question: Which preserved relations suffice to transfer one resource-allocation conclusion between a biological and a psychological case?
questions.next_result: One sourced case pair with an actual valid inference and a failed transfer caused by a missing premise.

questions.subject: Anticipation continuation construction
questions.question: When does building the next prompt expose a necessary contribution that direct response construction misses?
questions.next_result: A live case with retained alternative responses and their different continuations.

questions.subject: Anticipation influence attribution
questions.question: How much of expectation-outcome agreement comes from influencing the outcome rather than forecasting independently?
questions.next_result: A design that varies exposure to the expectation while retaining the original expectation record.

questions.subject: Uncertainty decision sensitivity
questions.question: Which unresolved distinction changes the selected next operation rather than only its explanation?
questions.next_result: A sensitivity result with a decision that changes at an identified distinction.

questions.subject: Resource use avoidable cost
questions.question: Which apparent inefficiencies disappear when exploration, information or option preservation enters the fixed task standard?
questions.next_result: One measured or fully specified comparison with the omitted contribution restored.

questions.subject: Deviation effect robustness
questions.question: Which benefits survive changes in admissible contexts without redefining the objective after seeing the outcome?
questions.next_result: An explicit context set with at least one separating failure.

questions.subject: Conflict resolution method applicability
questions.question: When does changing the sequence of access create a genuinely feasible joint improvement?
questions.next_result: A live conflict model with evidenced timing, resource and agreement constraints.

questions.subject: Subject name substitution effect
questions.question: Which literal name changes alter inference with the underlying definition held fixed?
questions.next_result: A fixed-content comparison that distinguishes wording effects from definition effects.

questions.subject: Memory active content interference control
questions.question: Which source-listed paradigms separate maintenance failure from updating demands and interference control?
questions.next_result: A task-specific construct comparison using the original paradigm evidence, beyond the functional branch inventory.

source_boundary.domain: NIMH RDoC Working Memory functional branch
source_boundary.inventory_rule: The root construct plus all four immediately listed functional subconstructs and the defining qualifications on the root page. All five pages were read. Child-page biological and paradigm labels are preserved separately as source associations.
source_boundary.coverage_claim: Five of five functional labels reconciled; five defining qualifications retained. No further functional child is listed on the inspected child pages.
source_boundary.outside_claim: This is not coverage of all working-memory theories, every linked study, mechanisms, task variants or the whole RDoC matrix.

source_qualifications.consequence: State which content matters to the task; items, goals and strategies are examples, not three exclusive child subjects.
Investigate whether and how relevant elements are associated in the case; do not require binding as an earlier step for every use.

source_qualifications.force: Internal maintenance can occur without external support
subjects: Memory active content external support dependence
source_qualifications.consequence: Compare stated support conditions instead of requiring every task to be externally unsupported.
Measure usability over time under stated conditions; do not assume a single expiry time.
Separate delay from competing material before attributing loss to elapsed time alone.
